name: Roro
catalog_citation: Strong, W. M. 1914. The Roro and Mekeo languages of British New Guinea. Zeitschrift für Kolonialsprachen 4(4): 285-311. Berlin: Reimer. (archive.org item afrikaundberse0404meinuoft)
catalog_locator: p. 286, section 'Roro. Accent.' (PDF page 32 of the archive.org scan)
catalog_quote: Roro. Accent. In words with two syllables the accent is on the first syllable. In words with three syllables the accent is on the first syllable if it contains a diphthong but otherwise on the second syllable. In words with more than three syllables the accent is on the second syllable.

audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding quotation is verbatim on Strong 1914 p. 286 in the held page image and scanned. (2) Deciding source: a 1914 27-pp colonial grammar sketch whose accent paragraph has no examples; Hayes 1980 and StressTyp2 merely restate it.
